from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class MonthlyHousingReport(BaseModel):
    """One month of housing starts data extracted from a specific report."""
    data_month: str = Field(description="The month of the housing starts data in YYYY-MM format")
    saar_value: str = Field(description="The Seasonally Adjusted Annual Rate (SAAR) value for that month")
    growth_percentage: str = Field(description="The month-over-month growth rate (e.g., '10.7%', '-14.8%')")
    report_release_date: str = Field(description="The date the report was released, used to enforce precedence")
    report_number: str = Field(description="The unique release number of the report if available")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    monthly_reports: list[MonthlyHousingReport]
